question: Tilaiya Ultra Mega Power Project is located in which of the following state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tilaiya Ultra mega power Project in Jharkhand.

 
 
• It is owned by Reliance Power.
 
• Its capacity is 3960 and the source is a local coal mine.
